Container.Name: filex
Container.Overview:
filex is a self-hosted web file manager. It browses, uploads, previews, shares and edits files on local folders and on S3, SFTP, WebDAV, FTP and SMB storage, and serves the same files over S3, SFTP, FTPS, NFS and WebDAV for tools such as rclone, restic or WinSCP.
It has share links with a PIN, an expiry date and a download limit, upload-only links, full-text search, thumbnails, trash and version history, end-to-end encrypted folders, roles and groups, two-factor sign-in, and optional OIDC or LDAP sign-in. Add-on apps run in a WebAssembly sandbox and are installed from the admin panel; Word, Excel and PowerPoint files open in the browser once you install the office editor app.
Setup: map the share you want to manage to Files and set Public URL to the address you open filex at, for example http://192.168.1.10:5212. On the first start filex creates the administrator admin@local and prints its password once in the container log (also saved to .first-run.txt in the Data folder), unless you fill in Admin Email and Admin Password. The administrator signs in at /admin; accounts you create for other people sign in at /drive. Documentation: https://docs.filex.sh

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: filex database (SQLite), search index, thumbnail cache and the first-run password file.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: The share filex manages, for example /mnt/user/files. It becomes the first storage on the first start; more storages can be added in the admin panel.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open filex at, for example http://192.168.1.10:5212 or https://files.example.com. Share links and sign-in redirects are built from it.

Config.Name: Admin Email
Config.Description: Optional. Email of the first administrator. Leave empty for admin@local.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional. Password of the first administrator. Leave empty for a random password, printed once in the container log.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Optional. 32 or more random characters used to encrypt stored secrets (S3 access keys, push notifications, sign-in provider secrets). Back it up and keep it unchanged once set.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID filex runs as. 99 is the Unraid user nobody. Leave empty to run as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID filex runs as. 100 is the Unraid group users.

Config.Name: Default Storage Driver
Config.Description: Storage created on the first start. Keep local to use the Files share.

Config.Name: Default Storage Path
Config.Description: Container path of the storage created on the first start. Matches the Files mapping.
